_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts.
picture: Python Explained: What It Is, How It Runs Your Code, Bytecode, Memory and the GIL (Python 3.15)
start: Start a Python Project the Right Way: Virtual Environments, main.py, the REPL and Your First Errors
hold: Python Data Types for Beginners: Numbers, Decimal for Money, Strings, Lists, Tuples, Dicts and Sets
process: Python Control Flow and Functions: if, match, Loops, Comprehensions, Exceptions and Generators
extract: Reading Files in Python: open and with, Encodings, pathlib, CSV, JSON and Streaming Rows
transform: Python Data Aggregation: Grouping, Counter, Sorting, Statistics, Dates and itertools
load: Writing Data in Python: CSV Reports, f-strings, JSON, SQLite Transactions and Safe Re-runs
structure: Structure a Python Project: Modules, Packages, __main__, Type Hints, pyproject.toml and mypy
model: Object-Oriented Python: Classes, Dataclasses, Properties, Inheritance, Protocols and Context Managers
trust: Testing Python Code: pytest, Fixtures, Test Doubles, Logging, Decorators, pdb and ruff
speed: Make Python Fast: Profiling, Sets, tracemalloc, Threads and the GIL, Free-Threading, Processes and asyncio
ship: Ship a Python Project: argparse CLIs, Configuration and Secrets, Wheels, cron and Exit Codes
